convention.scope: logical arithmetic of observed ATen graph plus explicitly enumerated Python scalar formulas
convention.special: sqrt, exp, general power each 1 logical special-function operation; separately reported
convention.convolution: dense direct full-kernel MAC convention, including zero padding; bias add counted separately
convention.backward: actual requested input/weight/bias gradient masks; no forward multiplier shortcut
convention.prelu: dense piecewise candidate arithmetic: 1 multiply/element forward; 2 backward; comparisons separate
convention.sigmoid: 1 negate + 1 exp + 1 add + 1 reciprocal per element; backward 3 basic operations/element
convention.mse: mean squared error 3N basic operations (subtract, square, N-1 adds, divide); backward 3N plus scalar 2/N
convention.reductions: sum of R elements into O outputs counts R-O additions
convention.random: normal draws counted as random primitives, RNG implementation internal arithmetic excluded
convention.zero_cost: allocation, copying, views, indexing/padding, scalar extraction and profiler/control metadata excluded from floating arithmetic
not_counted: backend instruction algorithms, vectorization and FMA fusion
